## Specification

### Component: Data table

A table with sorting, search, per-column filters, row selection, pagination, column visibility, empty and loading states. Built on Table (see table.md), Checkbox, Button, Input, NativeSelect and DropdownMenu. Every piece of state is controlled **or** uncontrolled.

#### Anatomy
```
<DataTable columns data>            .ui-data-table (flex column, gap 12px)
  toolbar                           .ui-data-table-toolbar: search (left) · extra controls + Columns menu (right)
  <Table>                           see table.md
    header row                      optional checkbox column · titles (sort buttons)
    filter row (if any column.filter)
    body                            rows · or skeleton rows (loading) · or the empty row
  pagination                        "Showing 1–10 of 42" · rows per page · "Page 1 of 5" · prev / next
  bulk bar                          floating, rises in while rows are selected
  live region                       role="status", visually hidden
```

#### Column definition
`{ id, header, label?, accessor?, cell?, sortable?, compare?, searchable?, searchText?, filter?, filterFn?, align?, width?, hidden?, hideable?, className?, headerClassName? }`
- `accessor`: a key of the row, or `(row) => value`. Used for display, sort, search, filter.
- `cell({ row, value, index, rowId })`: custom render (badges, actions).
- `filter({ value, onChange, label })`: control for the filter row; `filterFn(row, value)` or a default "contains" match on the accessor value.
- `align: 'right'` right-aligns the cell and gives it tabular figures.

#### Props
- Data: `columns`, `data`, `getRowId` (default `row.id`, else index), `label`, `caption`, `rowLabel` (singular noun, default "row").
- Table look: `striped`, `compact`, `bordered`, `stickyHeader`, `maxHeight`.
- Search: `searchable` (default true), `searchPlaceholder`, `searchDebounce` (200ms), `search` / `defaultSearch` / `onSearchChange`.
- Sort: `sort` / `defaultSort` / `onSortChange` — `{ id, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' } | null`.
- Filters: `columnFilters` / `defaultColumnFilters` / `onColumnFiltersChange` — `Record<columnId, string>`.
- Selection: `selectable`, `selectedRowIds` / `defaultSelectedRowIds` / `onSelectedRowIdsChange`, `selectRowLabel(row)`, `bulkActions({ selectedRows, selectedIds, clearSelection })`.
- Pagination: `paginated` (default true), `page` (1-based) / `defaultPage` / `onPageChange`, `pageSize` / `defaultPageSize` / `onPageSizeChange`, `pageSizeOptions` (default 10, 25, 50).
- Columns menu: `columnsMenu` (default true), `columnVisibility` / `defaultColumnVisibility` / `onColumnVisibilityChange`.
- States: `loading`, `emptyState`, `toolbar` (extra controls).

#### Behaviour
- Pipeline: filter (search AND column filters) → sort → paginate. Pure helpers: `dataTableFilterRows`, `dataTableSortRows`, `dataTablePaginate`.
- Sort button cycles asc → desc → none. Sort is stable; empty values stay last in both directions. `aria-sort` on every sortable header (`ascending`, `descending`, `none`).
- Search commits after the debounce; Esc or the clear button empties it at once. Changing search, filters, sort or page size returns to page 1; an out-of-range page is clamped.
- Header checkbox selects every row **on the current page** (indeterminate when some are). Selection persists across pages. Footer shows "n of m selected".
- Bulk bar appears when n > 0 with the app's `bulkActions` plus a Clear button; it exits when the selection empties.
- Columns menu: checkbox items; choosing one keeps the menu open; the last visible column cannot be hidden.
- Empty: one full-width row with icon, "No {rows} found", and a "Clear filters" button when filters are active. Loading: up to 10 skeleton rows, `aria-busy` on the table.
- A polite live region announces the result count and sort.

#### Visual rules
- Sort button sits flush with the cell text (−8px margin), 12px / 500, hover tint `--ui-accent`, active column `--ui-foreground`; arrow icon 14px (up, down, or up-down when unsorted at 60%).
- Selection column 44px wide. Pagination text 14px `--ui-muted-foreground`, tabular-nums.
- Bulk bar: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-xl`, `--ui-shadow-lg`, centred, 20px above the viewport bottom (sticky dock); wraps full-width on phones.

#### Motion
- Bulk bar enters with `ui-pop-in` (380ms, rises 8px), exits with `ui-pop-out` (160ms). Empty content pops in. Sorted-arrow pops in 150ms.

#### Accessibility
- Native table; checkboxes labelled ("Select all rows on this page", `selectRowLabel`). Sort controls are real buttons. Search field has an `aria-label`. Prev / next buttons labelled.

#### Acceptance checks
- Click Amount: ascending, then descending, then original order; `aria-sort` follows.
- Typing in search filters after ~200ms and resets to page 1; "Showing 1–n of m" updates.
- Select-all on a page checks only that page; the bulk bar rises in; Clear removes it.
- Hiding a column removes it from header and cells; at least one stays.
- Empty search shows the empty row; `loading` shows skeletons without layout jump.

### `ui/components/data-table/data-table-bulk-bar.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { usePresence } from '../../hooks/use-presence';
import { Button } from '../button';

export interface DataTableBulkBarProps {
  count: number;
  onClear: () => void;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Floating bar that rises in when rows are selected and sinks out when the
 * selection is cleared. It docks to the bottom of the viewport while the table is in view.
 */
export function DataTableBulkBar({ count, onClear, children }: DataTableBulkBarProps) {
  const present = count > 0;
  const { mounted, state, ref } = usePresence<HTMLDivElement>(present);
  // Keep the last content while the exit animation runs
  const last = useRef({ count, children });
  if (present) last.current = { count, children };
  if (!mounted) return null;
  return (
    <div className="ui-data-table-bulk-dock">
      <div ref={ref} role="region" aria-label="Bulk actions" data-state={state} className="ui-data-table-bulk">
        <span className="ui-data-table-bulk-count">{last.current.count} selected</span>
        <span className="ui-data-table-bulk-actions">{last.current.children}</span>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClear} disabled={!present}>
          Clear
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/data-table/data-table-head.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Checkbox } from '../checkbox';
import { TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '../table';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableSort } from './types';

export interface DataTableHeadProps<T> {
  columns: DataTableColumn<T>[];
  labels: Record<string, string>;
  sort: DataTableSort | null;
  onSort: (columnId: string) => void;
  selectable: boolean;
  allSelected: boolean;
  someSelected: boolean;
  disableSelectAll: boolean;
  onToggleAll: (checked: boolean) => void;
  filters: Record<string, string>;
  onFilterChange: (columnId: string, value: string) => void;
}

/** Header rows: titles (with sort buttons), then the optional per-column filter row. */
export function DataTableHead<T>({
  columns,
  labels,
  sort,
  onSort,
  selectable,
  allSelected,
  someSelected,
  disableSelectAll,
  onToggleAll,
  filters,
  onFilterChange,
}: DataTableHeadProps<T>) {
  const hasFilters = columns.some((column) => column.filter);
  return (
    <TableHeader>
      <TableRow>
        {selectable && (
          <TableHead className="ui-data-table-select">
            <Checkbox
              size="sm"
              aria-label="Select all rows on this page"
              checked={allSelected}
              indeterminate={someSelected && !allSelected}
              disabled={disableSelectAll}
              onCheckedChange={onToggleAll}
            />
          </TableHead>
        )}
        {columns.map((column) => {
          const direction = sort && sort.id === column.id ? sort.direction : null;
          return (
            <TableHead
              key={column.id}
              align={column.align}
              className={column.headerClassName}
              style={column.width !== undefined ? { width: column.width } : undefined}
              aria-sort={column.sortable ? (direction === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : direction === 'desc' ? 'descending' : 'none') : undefined}
            >
              {column.sortable ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="ui-data-table-sort"
                  data-direction={direction ?? undefined}
                  onClick={() => onSort(column.id)}
                >
                  <span>{column.header}</span>
                  <Icon
                    key={direction ?? 'none'}
                    name={direction === 'asc' ? 'arrow-up' : direction === 'desc' ? 'arrow-down' : 'chevrons-up-down'}
                    size={14}
                    className="ui-data-table-sort-icon"
                  />
                </button>
              ) : (
                column.header
              )}
            </TableHead>
          );
        })}
      </TableRow>
      {hasFilters && (
        <TableRow className="ui-data-table-filter-row">
          {selectable && <TableCell className="ui-data-table-select" />}
          {columns.map((column) => (
            <TableCell key={column.id} align={column.align}>
              {column.filter?.({
                value: filters[column.id] ?? '',
                onChange: (value) => onFilterChange(column.id, value),
                label: labels[column.id] ?? column.id,
              })}
            </TableCell>
          ))}
        </TableRow>
      )}
    </TableHeader>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/data-table/data-table-pagination.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useId } from 'react';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Button } from '../button';
import { NativeSelect } from '../native-select';

export interface DataTablePaginationProps {
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
  from: number;
  to: number;
  total: number;
  pageSize: number;
  pageSizeOptions: readonly number[];
  rowLabel: string;
  /** Text shown on the left after the range, e.g. "3 of 42 selected". */
  summary?: string;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange: (size: number) => void;
}

/** Range text, rows-per-page select and previous / next buttons. */
export function DataTablePagination({
  page,
  pageCount,
  from,
  to,
  total,
  pageSize,
  pageSizeOptions,
  rowLabel,
  summary,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
}: DataTablePaginationProps) {
  const selectId = useId();
  return (
    <div className="ui-data-table-pagination">
      <p className="ui-data-table-range">
        {total === 0 ? `No ${rowLabel}s` : `Showing ${from}–${to} of ${total}`}
        {summary ? <span className="ui-data-table-summary"> · {summary}</span> : null}
      </p>
      <div className="ui-data-table-pager">
        {pageSizeOptions.length > 1 && (
          <div className="ui-data-table-page-size">
            <label htmlFor={selectId}>Rows per page</label>
            <NativeSelect
              id={selectId}
              size="sm"
              value={String(pageSize)}
              onChange={(e) => onPageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value))}
            >
              {pageSizeOptions.map((option) => (
                <option key={option} value={option}>
                  {option}
                </option>
              ))}
            </NativeSelect>
          </div>
        )}
        <span className="ui-data-table-page-label">
          Page {page} of {pageCount}
        </span>
        <div className="ui-data-table-pager-buttons">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon
            aria-label="Previous page"
            disabled={page <= 1}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}
          >
            <Icon name="chevron-left" />
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon
            aria-label="Next page"
            disabled={page >= pageCount}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}
          >
            <Icon name="chevron-right" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/data-table/data-table-toolbar.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useDebouncedCallback } from '../../hooks/use-debounced-callback';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Button } from '../button';
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuTrigger } from '../dropdown-menu';
import { Input, InputAction, InputGroup, InputIcon } from '../input';

export interface DataTableSearchProps {
  /** Committed (debounced) query. */
  value: string;
  onValueChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder: string;
  label: string;
  debounce: number;
}

/** Search field: typing is instant, the query is committed after `debounce` ms. */
export function DataTableSearch({ value, onValueChange, placeholder, label, debounce }: DataTableSearchProps) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
  const [commit, cancel] = useDebouncedCallback(onValueChange, debounce);

  // A committed change from outside (a "clear filters" button, controlled state) replaces the draft
  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(value);
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <InputGroup size="sm" className="ui-data-table-search">
      <InputIcon>
        <Icon name="search" />
      </InputIcon>
      <Input
        type="search"
        value={draft}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        aria-label={label}
        autoComplete="off"
        onChange={(e) => {
          setDraft(e.target.value);
          commit(e.target.value);
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && draft !== '') {
            e.preventDefault();
            cancel();
            setDraft('');
            onValueChange('');
          }
        }}
      />
      <InputAction
        aria-label="Clear search"
        hidden={draft === ''}
        onClick={() => {
          cancel();
          setDraft('');
          onValueChange('');
        }}
      >
        <Icon name="x" />
      </InputAction>
    </InputGroup>
  );
}

export interface DataTableColumnsMenuProps {
  columns: Array<{ id: string; label: string; visible: boolean; disabled: boolean }>;
  onVisibleChange: (id: string, visible: boolean) => void;
}

/** "Columns" dropdown with one checkbox item per hideable column. */
export function DataTableColumnsMenu({ columns, onVisibleChange }: DataTableColumnsMenuProps) {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
          <Icon name="settings" />
          Columns
        </Button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent placement="bottom-end">
        <DropdownMenuLabel>Toggle columns</DropdownMenuLabel>
        {columns.map((column) => (
          <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
            key={column.id}
            checked={column.visible}
            disabled={column.disabled}
            onCheckedChange={(checked) => onVisibleChange(column.id, checked)}
            onSelect={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
          >
            {column.label}
          </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
        ))}
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}

export interface DataTableToolbarProps {
  children: ReactNode;
}

export function DataTableToolbar({ children }: DataTableToolbarProps) {
  return <div className="ui-data-table-toolbar">{children}</div>;
}
```

### `ui/components/data-table/data-table.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useMemo, type ForwardedRef, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactElement, type ReactNode, type Ref } from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Checkbox } from '../checkbox';
import { Skeleton } from '../skeleton';
import { Button } from '../button';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableRow } from '../table';
import { DataTableBulkBar } from './data-table-bulk-bar';
import { DataTableHead } from './data-table-head';
import { DataTablePagination } from './data-table-pagination';
import { DataTableColumnsMenu, DataTableSearch, DataTableToolbar } from './data-table-toolbar';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableSort } from './types';
import {
  dataTableDeselectIds,
  dataTableFilterRows,
  dataTableNextDirection,
  dataTablePaginate,
  dataTableSelectIds,
  dataTableSortRows,
  dataTableToggleId,
  dataTableToText,
} from './utils';

export interface DataTableBulkApi<T> {
  selectedRows: T[];
  selectedIds: string[];
  clearSelection: () => void;
}

export interface DataTableProps<T> extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children' | 'onChange'> {
  columns: DataTableColumn<T>[];
  data: readonly T[];
  /** Stable id per row (selection, keys). Default: `row.id`, else the row's index. */
  getRowId?: (row: T, index: number) => string;
  /** Accessible name of the table. */
  label?: string;
  /** Visible caption under the table. */
  caption?: ReactNode;
  /** Singular noun for counts: "payment" → "42 payments". Default "row". */
  rowLabel?: string;

  /** Table look (see Table). */
  striped?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  bordered?: boolean;
  stickyHeader?: boolean;
  maxHeight?: number | string;

  /** Show a global search field. Default true. */
  searchable?: boolean;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  /** Debounce before the query is applied, in ms. Default 200. */
  searchDebounce?: number;
  search?: string;
  defaultSearch?: string;
  onSearchChange?: (search: string) => void;

  sort?: DataTableSort | null;
  defaultSort?: DataTableSort | null;
  onSortChange?: (sort: DataTableSort | null) => void;

  /** Per-column filter values, keyed by column id. */
  columnFilters?: Record<string, string>;
  defaultColumnFilters?: Record<string, string>;
  onColumnFiltersChange?: (filters: Record<string, string>) => void;

  /** Adds a checkbox column. */
  selectable?: boolean;
  /** Selected row ids. */
  selectedRowIds?: string[];
  defaultSelectedRowIds?: string[];
  onSelectedRowIdsChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Accessible name of a row checkbox, e.g. `(row) => \`Select ${row.customer}\``. */
  selectRowLabel?: (row: T) => string;
  /** Content of the floating bar that appears while rows are selected. */
  bulkActions?: (api: DataTableBulkApi<T>) => ReactNode;

  /** Paginate rows. Default true. */
  paginated?: boolean;
  /** 1-based page. */
  page?: number;
  defaultPage?: number;
  onPageChange?: (page: number) => void;
  pageSize?: number;
  defaultPageSize?: number;
  onPageSizeChange?: (size: number) => void;
  /** Choices in the rows-per-page select. Default [10, 25, 50]. */
  pageSizeOptions?: number[];

  /** Show the "Columns" visibility menu. Default true. */
  columnsMenu?: boolean;
  /** Visibility by column id (missing ids follow the column's `hidden`). */
  columnVisibility?: Record<string, boolean>;
  defaultColumnVisibility?: Record<string, boolean>;
  onColumnVisibilityChange?: (visibility: Record<string, boolean>) => void;

  /** Shows skeleton rows instead of data. */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** Replaces the default "No results" message. */
  emptyState?: ReactNode;
  /** Extra controls in the toolbar, before the Columns menu. */
  toolbar?: ReactNode;
}

const NO_FILTERS: Record<string, string> = {};
const NO_VISIBILITY: Record<string, boolean> = {};
const NO_IDS: string[] = [];
const DEFAULT_SIZES = [10, 25, 50];

function defaultRowId(row: unknown, index: number): string {
  const id = (row as { id?: unknown } | null)?.id;
  return id !== undefined && id !== null ? String(id) : String(index);
}

function readValue<T>(column: DataTableColumn<T>, row: T): unknown {
  const { accessor } = column;
  if (typeof accessor === 'function') return accessor(row);
  if (accessor !== undefined) return row[accessor];
  return undefined;
}

function DataTableInner<T>(props: DataTableProps<T>, ref: ForwardedRef<HTMLDivElement>) {
  const {
    columns,
    data,
    getRowId = defaultRowId,
    label,
    caption,
    rowLabel = 'row',
    striped,
    compact,
    bordered,
    stickyHeader,
    maxHeight,
    searchable = true,
    searchPlaceholder = 'Search',
    searchDebounce = 200,
    search: searchProp,
    defaultSearch = '',
    onSearchChange,
    sort: sortProp,
    defaultSort = null,
    onSortChange,
    columnFilters: filtersProp,
    defaultColumnFilters = NO_FILTERS,
    onColumnFiltersChange,
    selectable = false,
    selectedRowIds: selectedProp,
    defaultSelectedRowIds = NO_IDS,
    onSelectedRowIdsChange,
    selectRowLabel,
    bulkActions,
    paginated = true,
    page: pageProp,
    defaultPage = 1,
    onPageChange,
    pageSize: pageSizeProp,
    defaultPageSize,
    onPageSizeChange,
    pageSizeOptions = DEFAULT_SIZES,
    columnsMenu = true,
    columnVisibility: visibilityProp,
    defaultColumnVisibility = NO_VISIBILITY,
    onColumnVisibilityChange,
    loading = false,
    emptyState,
    toolbar,
    className,
    ...rest
  } = props;

  const [search, setSearch] = useControllableState({ value: searchProp, defaultValue: defaultSearch, onChange: onSearchChange });
  const [sort, setSort] = useControllableState<DataTableSort | null>({ value: sortProp, defaultValue: defaultSort, onChange: onSortChange });
  const [filters, setFilters] = useControllableState({ value: filtersProp, defaultValue: defaultColumnFilters, onChange: onColumnFiltersChange });
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useControllableState({ value: selectedProp, defaultValue: defaultSelectedRowIds, onChange: onSelectedRowIdsChange });
  const [page, setPage] = useControllableState({ value: pageProp, defaultValue: defaultPage, onChange: onPageChange });
  const [pageSizeState, setPageSize] = useControllableState({
    value: pageSizeProp,
    defaultValue: defaultPageSize ?? pageSizeOptions[0] ?? 10,
    onChange: onPageSizeChange,
  });
  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useControllableState({ value: visibilityProp, defaultValue: defaultColumnVisibility, onChange: onColumnVisibilityChange });

  const pageSize = paginated ? pageSizeState : Infinity;

  const labels = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const column of columns) out[column.id] = column.label ?? (typeof column.header === 'string' ? column.header : column.id);
    return out;
  }, [columns]);

  const visibleColumns = useMemo(() => columns.filter((c) => visibility[c.id] ?? !c.hidden), [columns, visibility]);

  /* ---- derive rows: filter → sort → paginate ---- */
  const processed = useMemo(() => {
    const searchColumns = columns.filter((c) => c.searchable !== false && (c.accessor !== undefined || c.searchText));
    const predicates: Array<(row: T) => boolean> = [];
    for (const column of columns) {
      const value = (filters[column.id] ?? '').trim();
      if (!value) continue;
      if (column.filterFn) {
        const fn = column.filterFn;
        predicates.push((row) => fn(row, value));
      } else {
        const needle = value.toLowerCase();
        predicates.push((row) => dataTableToText(readValue(column, row)).toLowerCase().includes(needle));
      }
    }
    const filtered = dataTableFilterRows(data, {
      search,
      predicates,
      getSearchText: (row) =>
        searchColumns.map((c) => (c.searchText ? c.searchText(row) : dataTableToText(readValue(c, row)))).join(' '),
    });
    const sortColumn = sort ? columns.find((c) => c.id === sort.id) : undefined;
    if (!sort || !sortColumn) return filtered;
    return dataTableSortRows(filtered, {
      direction: sort.direction,
      compare: sortColumn.compare,
      getValue: (row) => readValue(sortColumn, row),
    });
  }, [columns, data, filters, search, sort]);

  const pageInfo = useMemo(() => dataTablePaginate(processed, page, pageSize), [processed, page, pageSize]);

  /* ---- selection ---- */
  const idByRow = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<T, string>();
    data.forEach((row, index) => map.set(row, getRowId(row, index)));
    return map;
  }, [data, getRowId]);
  const selectedSet = useMemo(() => new Set(selectedIds), [selectedIds]);
  const pageIds = pageInfo.rows.map((row, index) => idByRow.get(row) ?? String(index));
  const pageSelectedCount = pageIds.filter((id) => selectedSet.has(id)).length;
  const selectedRows = useMemo(
    () => (selectable ? data.filter((row) => selectedSet.has(idByRow.get(row) ?? '')) : []),
    [selectable, data, selectedSet, idByRow],
  );
  const clearSelection = () => setSelectedIds([]);

  /* ---- handlers ---- */
  const handleSort = (columnId: string) => {
    const current = sort && sort.id === columnId ? sort.direction : null;
    const next = dataTableNextDirection(current);
    setSort(next ? { id: columnId, direction: next } : null);
    setPage(1);
  };
  const handleSearch = (value: string) => {
    setSearch(value);
    setPage(1);
  };
  const handleFilter = (columnId: string, value: string) => {
    setFilters({ ...filters, [columnId]: value });
    setPage(1);
  };
  const filtersActive = search.trim() !== '' || Object.values(filters).some((v) => v.trim() !== '');
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearch('');
    setFilters({});
    setPage(1);
  };

  const columnMenuItems = columns
    .filter((c) => c.hideable !== false)
    .map((c) => {
      const visible = visibility[c.id] ?? !c.hidden;
      return { id: c.id, label: labels[c.id] ?? c.id, visible, disabled: visible && visibleColumns.length <= 1 };
    });
  const showColumnsMenu = columnsMenu && columnMenuItems.length > 0;
  const showToolbar = searchable || showColumnsMenu || toolbar != null;

  const colSpan = visibleColumns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0);
  const plural = `${rowLabel}s`;
  const skeletonRows = Math.min(Number.isFinite(pageSize) ? pageSize : 10, 10);
  const sortLabel = sort ? labels[sort.id] : undefined;
  const announcement = loading
    ? 'Loading'
    : `${processed.length} ${processed.length === 1 ? rowLabel : plural}${
        sort && sortLabel ? `, sorted by ${sortLabel} ${sort.direction === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : 'descending'}` : ''
      }`;
  const summary = selectable && selectedRows.length > 0 ? `${selectedRows.length} of ${data.length} selected` : undefined;

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-data-table', className)} {...rest}>
      {showToolbar && (
        <DataTableToolbar>
          {searchable ? (
            <DataTableSearch
              value={search}
              onValueChange={handleSearch}
              placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
              label={`Search ${plural}`}
              debounce={searchDebounce}
            />
          ) : (
            <span />
          )}
          <div className="ui-data-table-toolbar-end">
            {toolbar}
            {showColumnsMenu && (
              <DataTableColumnsMenu
                columns={columnMenuItems}
                onVisibleChange={(id, visible) => setVisibility({ ...visibility, [id]: visible })}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </DataTableToolbar>
      )}

      <Table
        label={label}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-busy={loading || undefined}
        striped={striped}
        compact={compact}
        bordered={bordered}
        stickyHeader={stickyHeader}
        maxHeight={maxHeight}
      >
        {caption != null && <TableCaption>{caption}</TableCaption>}
        <DataTableHead
          columns={visibleColumns}
          labels={labels}
          sort={sort}
          onSort={handleSort}
          selectable={selectable}
          allSelected={pageIds.length > 0 && pageSelectedCount === pageIds.length}
          someSelected={pageSelectedCount > 0}
          disableSelectAll={loading || pageIds.length === 0}
          onToggleAll={(checked) => setSelectedIds(checked ? dataTableSelectIds(selectedIds, pageIds) : dataTableDeselectIds(selectedIds, pageIds))}
          filters={filters}
          onFilterChange={handleFilter}
        />
        <TableBody>
          {loading &&
            Array.from({ length: skeletonRows }, (_, rowIndex) => (
              <TableRow key={`skeleton-${rowIndex}`} aria-hidden="true">
                {selectable && (
                  <TableCell className="ui-data-table-select">
                    <Skeleton width={16} height={16} />
                  </TableCell>
                )}
                {visibleColumns.map((column, colIndex) => (
                  <TableCell key={column.id} align={column.align}>
                    <Skeleton
                      width={`${55 + ((rowIndex * 7 + colIndex * 13) % 35)}%`}
                      height={14}
                      className={column.align === 'right' ? 'ui-data-table-skeleton-end' : undefined}
                    />
                  </TableCell>
                ))}
              </TableRow>
            ))}

          {!loading && pageInfo.rows.length === 0 && (
            <TableRow>
              <TableCell colSpan={Math.max(colSpan, 1)} className="ui-data-table-empty">
                {emptyState ?? (
                  <div className="ui-data-table-empty-content">
                    <span className="ui-data-table-empty-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                      <Icon name="search" size={18} />
                    </span>
                    <p className="ui-data-table-empty-title">No {plural} found</p>
                    <p className="ui-data-table-empty-text">
                      {filtersActive ? 'Try a different search or clear the filters.' : `There are no ${plural} to show yet.`}
                    </p>
                    {filtersActive && (
                      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={clearFilters}>
                        Clear filters
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          )}

          {!loading &&
            pageInfo.rows.map((row, index) => {
              const rowId = pageIds[index]!;
              const selected = selectedSet.has(rowId);
              return (
                <TableRow key={rowId} selected={selected}>
                  {selectable && (
                    <TableCell className="ui-data-table-select">
                      <Checkbox
                        size="sm"
                        aria-label={selectRowLabel ? selectRowLabel(row) : 'Select row'}
                        checked={selected}
                        onCheckedChange={() => setSelectedIds(dataTableToggleId(selectedIds, rowId))}
                      />
                    </TableCell>
                  )}
                  {visibleColumns.map((column) => {
                    const value = readValue(column, row);
                    return (
                      <TableCell key={column.id} align={column.align} numeric={column.align === 'right'} className={column.className}>
                        {column.cell ? column.cell({ row, value, index, rowId }) : dataTableToText(value)}
                      </TableCell>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableRow>
              );
            })}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>

      {paginated && (
        <DataTablePagination
          page={pageInfo.page}
          pageCount={pageInfo.pageCount}
          from={pageInfo.from}
          to={pageInfo.to}
          total={pageInfo.total}
          pageSize={pageSizeState}
          pageSizeOptions={pageSizeOptions}
          rowLabel={rowLabel}
          summary={summary}
          onPageChange={setPage}
          onPageSizeChange={(size) => {
            setPageSize(size);
            setPage(1);
          }}
        />
      )}
      {!paginated && summary && <p className="ui-data-table-range">{summary}</p>}

      {selectable && bulkActions && (
        <DataTableBulkBar count={selectedRows.length} onClear={clearSelection}>
          {selectedRows.length > 0 ? bulkActions({ selectedRows, selectedIds, clearSelection }) : null}
        </DataTableBulkBar>
      )}

      <div className="ui-data-table-live" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {announcement}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * DataTable — a Table with sorting, search, per-column filters, row selection,
 * pagination, column visibility, empty and loading states. Every piece of state is
 * controlled or uncontrolled. Rows are derived by small pure helpers (filter → sort → paginate).
 */
export const DataTable = forwardRef(DataTableInner) as <T>(
  props: DataTableProps<T> & { ref?: Ref<HTMLDivElement> },
) => ReactElement | null;
```

```ts
export type {
  DataTableColumn,
  DataTableCellContext,
  DataTableFilterContext,
  DataTableSort,
  DataTableSortDirection,
} from './types';

  dataTableCompareValues,
  dataTableFilterRows,
  dataTableNextDirection,
  dataTablePaginate,
  dataTableSortRows,
```

### `ui/components/data-table/types.ts`

```ts
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { TableAlign } from '../table';

export type DataTableSortDirection = 'asc' | 'desc';

export interface DataTableSort {
  /** Column id. */
  id: string;
  direction: DataTableSortDirection;
}

export interface DataTableCellContext<T> {
  row: T;
  /** The raw value read through `accessor` (undefined without one). */
  value: unknown;
  /** Index of the row within the current page. */
  index: number;
  rowId: string;
}

export interface DataTableFilterContext {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  /** Plain-text column name, for aria-labels. */
  label: string;
}

export interface DataTableColumn<T> {
  /** Unique, stable id (used for sort, filters and visibility state). */
  id: string;
  /** Header content. */
  header: ReactNode;
  /** Plain-text name for the columns menu and announcements. Defaults to `header` when it is a string. */
  label?: string;
  /** A key of the row, or a function returning the value shown, sorted and searched. */
  accessor?: keyof T | ((row: T) => unknown);
  /** Custom cell. Without it the accessor value is rendered as text. */
  cell?: (context: DataTableCellContext<T>) => ReactNode;
  /** Header becomes a sort button (asc → desc → none). */
  sortable?: boolean;
  /** Custom comparator, ascending. Defaults to numbers, dates and natural string order. */
  compare?: (a: T, b: T) => number;
  /** Include in the global search. Default true when the column has an accessor. */
  searchable?: boolean;
  /** Text the global search matches for this column. Defaults to the accessor value. */
  searchText?: (row: T) => string;
  /** Per-column filter control, rendered under the header. Pair with `filterFn` or use the default contains-match. */
  filter?: (context: DataTableFilterContext) => ReactNode;
  /** Does the row pass this column's filter value? Default: case-insensitive "contains" on the accessor value. */
  filterFn?: (row: T, filterValue: string) => boolean;
  align?: TableAlign;
  /** Column width (number is px). */
  width?: number | string;
  /** Hidden initially (the columns menu can show it). */
  hidden?: boolean;
  /** Offer this column in the columns menu. Default true. */
  hideable?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  headerClassName?: string;
}
```

### `ui/components/data-table/utils.ts`

```ts
import type { DataTableSortDirection } from './types';

/* Pure helpers behind DataTable: no React, fully unit-tested. */

const collator = new Intl.Collator(undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });

function isNil(value: unknown): value is null | undefined {
  return value === null || value === undefined || (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isNaN(value));
}

/** Ascending comparison of two cell values. Empty values sort last; numbers, dates and booleans compare by value. */
export function dataTableCompareValues(a: unknown, b: unknown): number {
  const aNil = isNil(a);
  const bNil = isNil(b);
  if (aNil || bNil) return aNil && bNil ? 0 : aNil ? 1 : -1;
  if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') return a - b;
  if (typeof a === 'bigint' && typeof b === 'bigint') return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
  if (a instanceof Date && b instanceof Date) return a.getTime() - b.getTime();
  if (typeof a === 'boolean' && typeof b === 'boolean') return Number(a) - Number(b);
  return collator.compare(String(a), String(b));
}

/** none → asc → desc → none. */
export function dataTableNextDirection(current: DataTableSortDirection | null): DataTableSortDirection | null {
  if (current === null) return 'asc';
  return current === 'asc' ? 'desc' : null;
}

export interface SortOptions<T> {
  direction: DataTableSortDirection;
  /** Value to compare. Ignored when `compare` is set. */
  getValue?: (row: T) => unknown;
  /** Custom ascending comparator. */
  compare?: (a: T, b: T) => number;
}

/** Stable sort that never mutates its input. Empty values stay last in both directions. */
export function dataTableSortRows<T>(rows: readonly T[], options: SortOptions<T> | null): T[] {
  if (!options) return rows.slice();
  const { direction, getValue, compare } = options;
  const factor = direction === 'desc' ? -1 : 1;
  const decorated = rows.map((row, index) => ({ row, index, value: compare ? undefined : getValue?.(row) }));
  decorated.sort((x, y) => {
    let result: number;
    if (compare) {
      result = compare(x.row, y.row) * factor;
    } else if (isNil(x.value) || isNil(y.value)) {
      result = dataTableCompareValues(x.value, y.value); // empties last, regardless of direction
    } else {
      result = dataTableCompareValues(x.value, y.value) * factor;
    }
    return result !== 0 ? result : x.index - y.index;
  });
  return decorated.map((d) => d.row);
}

/** Lower-cased text for a cell value (empty for null, objects and functions). */
export function dataTableToText(value: unknown): string {
  if (isNil(value)) return '';
  if (value instanceof Date) return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? '' : value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean' || typeof value === 'bigint') {
    return String(value);
  }
  return '';
}

export interface FilterOptions<T> {
  /** Global search query. Every whitespace-separated word must appear (AND). */
  search?: string;
  /** Text to search for a row. */
  getSearchText?: (row: T) => string;
  /** Extra per-row tests (per-column filters); a row must pass them all. */
  predicates?: ReadonlyArray<(row: T) => boolean>;
}

export function dataTableFilterRows<T>(rows: readonly T[], { search = '', getSearchText, predicates = [] }: FilterOptions<T>): T[] {
  const words = search.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0 && predicates.length === 0) return rows.slice();
  return rows.filter((row) => {
    if (!predicates.every((test) => test(row))) return false;
    if (words.length === 0) return true;
    const text = (getSearchText ? getSearchText(row) : '').toLowerCase();
    return words.every((word) => text.includes(word));
  });
}

export interface PageResult<T> {
  rows: T[];
  /** The page actually shown (1-based, clamped into range). */
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
  total: number;
  /** 1-based index of the first / last row shown (0 when empty). */
  from: number;
  to: number;
}

/** Slice one page. `pageSize` of 0, Infinity or less means "all rows". The page is clamped into range. */
export function dataTablePaginate<T>(rows: readonly T[], page: number, pageSize: number): PageResult<T> {
  const total = rows.length;
  const size = Number.isFinite(pageSize) && pageSize > 0 ? Math.floor(pageSize) : Math.max(total, 1);
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size));
  const current = Math.min(Math.max(1, Math.floor(page) || 1), pageCount);
  const start = (current - 1) * size;
  const slice = rows.slice(start, start + size);
  return {
    rows: slice,
    page: current,
    pageCount,
    total,
    from: total === 0 ? 0 : start + 1,
    to: start + slice.length,
  };
}

/** Add ids (without duplicates), keeping order. */
export function dataTableSelectIds(selected: readonly string[], ids: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const set = new Set(selected);
  const out = selected.slice();
  for (const id of ids) {
    if (!set.has(id)) {
      set.add(id);
      out.push(id);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Remove ids. */
export function dataTableDeselectIds(selected: readonly string[], ids: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const drop = new Set(ids);
  return selected.filter((id) => !drop.has(id));
}

/** Add the id when missing, remove it when present. */
export function dataTableToggleId(selected: readonly string[], id: string): string[] {
  return selected.includes(id) ? selected.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...selected, id];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-debounced-callback.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

/**
 * Debounces a callback: it runs `delay` ms after the last call.
 * Returns `[call, cancel]`; the pending call is cancelled on unmount.
 * The latest `fn` is always the one that runs.
 */
export function useDebouncedCallback<A extends unknown[]>(fn: (...args: A) => void, delay: number) {
  const fnRef = useRef(fn);
  fnRef.current = fn;
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    if (timer.current !== null) {
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const call = useCallback(
    (...args: A) => {
      cancel();
      if (delay <= 0) {
        fnRef.current(...args);
        return;
      }
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        timer.current = null;
        fnRef.current(...args);
      }, delay);
    },
    [cancel, delay],
  );

  useEffect(() => cancel, [cancel]);

  return [call, cancel] as const;
}
```

```ts
/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/hooks/use-presence.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { animationsFinished } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Keeps an element mounted until its exit animation has finished.
 *   const { mounted, state, ref } = usePresence(open);
 *   {mounted && <div ref={ref} data-state={state} />}
 * CSS animates on [data-state="open" | "closed"]; nothing else is needed.
 */
export function usePresence<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(present: boolean) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(present);
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (present) {
      setMounted(true);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    animationsFinished(ref.current).then(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setMounted(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [present]);

  return {
    mounted: present || mounted,
    state: (present ? 'open' : 'closed') as 'open' | 'closed',
    ref,
  };
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/data-table.css`

```css
/* Data table --------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-data-table
     .ui-data-table-toolbar > .ui-data-table-search, .ui-data-table-toolbar-end
     (Table: .ui-table-wrap > .ui-table — see table.css)
       .ui-data-table-select (checkbox column), .ui-data-table-sort (header button,
       [data-direction="asc|desc"]), .ui-data-table-filter-row, .ui-data-table-empty
     .ui-data-table-pagination > .ui-data-table-range, .ui-data-table-pager
     .ui-data-table-bulk-dock > .ui-data-table-bulk[data-state="open|closed"]
     .ui-data-table-live (visually hidden status)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-data-table {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* Toolbar */
  .ui-data-table-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .ui-data-table-search { flex: 1 1 14rem; max-width: 20rem; }
  .ui-data-table-toolbar-end { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-inline-start: auto; }

  /* Selection column */
  .ui-data-table .ui-data-table-select { width: 2.75rem; padding-inline: 0.75rem 0; }
  .ui-data-table .ui-data-table-select .ui-checkbox { display: inline-flex; vertical-align: middle; }

  /* Sort button: label + icon, aligned with the cell text */
  .ui-data-table-sort {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    margin-inline: -0.5rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-data-table-sort:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-data-table-sort[data-direction] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-data-table-sort:hover { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-data-table-sort-icon { flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.6; }
  .ui-data-table-sort[data-direction] .ui-data-table-sort-icon {
    opacity: 1;
    animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-table-head[data-align="right"] .ui-data-table-sort { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
  .ui-table-head[data-align="center"] .ui-data-table-sort { margin-inline: auto; }

  /* Per-column filter row */
  .ui-data-table-filter-row > .ui-table-cell {
    height: auto;
    padding-block: 0.5rem;
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    border-bottom-color: var(--ui-border);
  }
  .ui-data-table-filter-row .ui-input,
  .ui-data-table-filter-row .ui-select-wrap { width: 100%; min-width: 6rem; }

  /* Skeleton rows */
  .ui-data-table-skeleton-end { margin-inline-start: auto; }

  /* Empty state */
  .ui-data-table .ui-data-table-empty { height: auto; padding: 2.5rem 1rem; text-align: center; }
  .ui-data-table-empty-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-data-table-empty-icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 2.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-data-table-empty-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-data-table-empty-text { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-sm); }

  /* Pagination */
  .ui-data-table-pagination {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-data-table-range { margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .ui-data-table-pager { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem 1rem; }
  .ui-data-table-page-size { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-data-table-page-size .ui-select-wrap { width: 4.75rem; }
  .ui-data-table-page-label { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ui-data-table-pager-buttons { display: flex; gap: 0.375rem; }

  /* Floating bulk-action bar: zero-height sticky dock, the bar rises from it */
  .ui-data-table-bulk-dock {
    position: sticky;
    bottom: 1.25rem;
    z-index: 5;
    height: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-data-table-bulk {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
    padding: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.5rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    translate: -50% 0;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  .ui-data-table-bulk[data-state="open"] { --ui-pop-y: 8px; animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-data-table-bulk[data-state="closed"] { --ui-pop-y: 4px; animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-data-table-bulk-count { font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ui-data-table-bulk-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; }
  @media (max-width: 36rem) {
    .ui-data-table-bulk { flex-wrap: wrap; width: calc(100vw - 2rem); }
  }

  /* Live region: announced, never seen */
  .ui-data-table-live {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Payments data table** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/data-table/payments.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { DataTable, type DataTableColumn } from '@/ui/components/data-table';
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger } from '@/ui/components/dropdown-menu';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

type Status = 'paid' | 'pending' | 'failed' | 'refunded';

interface Payment {
  id: string;
  customer: string;
  email: string;
  status: Status;
  method: string;
  amount: number;
  date: string;
}

const people = ['Amara Okafor', 'Liam Brennan', 'Sofia Marchetti', 'Noah Fischer', 'Yuki Tanaka', 'Priya Raman', 'Mateo Alvarez', 'Elena Petrova', 'Jonas Lindqvist', 'Hana Kim'];
const statuses: Status[] = ['paid', 'paid', 'pending', 'paid', 'failed', 'paid', 'refunded', 'pending'];
const methods = ['Visa', 'Mastercard', 'Bank transfer', 'PayPal'];

const payments: Payment[] = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => {
  const customer = people[i % people.length];
  const day = new Date(Date.UTC(2025, 10, 28 - i));
  return {
    id: `PAY-${1042 + i}`,
    customer,
    email: `${customer.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '.')}@example.com`,
    status: statuses[(i * 3) % statuses.length],
    method: methods[(i * 5) % methods.length],
    amount: ((i * 7919) % 94000) / 100 + 12,
    date: day.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
  };
});

const money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
const dateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
const tone = { paid: 'success', pending: 'warning', failed: 'destructive', refunded: 'secondary' } as const;

const columns: DataTableColumn<Payment>[] = [
  {
    id: 'customer',
    header: 'Customer',
    accessor: 'customer',
    sortable: true,
    searchText: (row) => `${row.customer} ${row.email}`,
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <div className="grid leading-tight">
        <span className="font-medium">{row.customer}</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{row.email}</span>
      </div>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: 'status',
    header: 'Status',
    accessor: 'status',
    sortable: true,
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <Badge variant={tone[row.status]} dot>
        {row.status[0].toUpperCase() + row.status.slice(1)}
      </Badge>
    ),
  },
  { id: 'method', header: 'Method', accessor: 'method', sortable: true },
  {
    id: 'date',
    header: 'Date',
    accessor: 'date',
    sortable: true,
    cell: ({ row }) => dateFormat.format(new Date(`${row.date}T00:00:00Z`)),
  },
  {
    id: 'amount',
    header: 'Amount',
    accessor: 'amount',
    sortable: true,
    align: 'right',
    cell: ({ row }) => money.format(row.amount),
  },
  {
    id: 'actions',
    header: <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>,
    label: 'Actions',
    hideable: false,
    align: 'right',
    width: 56,
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <DropdownMenu>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="xs" icon aria-label={`Actions for ${row.id}`}>
            <Icon name="more-horizontal" />
          </Button>
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>
        <DropdownMenuContent placement="bottom-end">
          <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(row.id)}>Copy payment ID</DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>View receipt</DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuItem disabled={row.status !== 'paid'}>Refund payment</DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
    ),
  },
];

export default function PaymentsDataTable() {
  const [exported, setExported] = useState<number | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <DataTable
        columns={columns}
        data={payments}
        label="Payments"
        rowLabel="payment"
        searchPlaceholder="Search payments"
        selectable
        selectRowLabel={(row) => `Select ${row.id}`}
        defaultSort={{ id: 'date', direction: 'desc' }}
        bulkActions={({ selectedRows, clearSelection }) => (
          <>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setExported(selectedRows.length);
                clearSelection();
              }}
            >
              <Icon name="download" />
              Export
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
              Refund
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
      />
      <p className="mt-3 h-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground" role="status">
        {exported !== null ? `Exported ${exported} ${exported === 1 ? 'payment' : 'payments'}.` : ''}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
